controls.title: The effectiveness of relevant cybersecurity education and training is persistently reviewed, including at least general training for all employees, role-specific training for employees in high risk ro

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The effectiveness of relevant cybersecurity education and training is persistently reviewed, including at least general training for all employees, role-specific training for employees in high risk roles, training for development and engineering staff on secure software delivery, and training for staff involved with incident response or disaster recovery.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Modifications to the cloud service offering are logged and monitored.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Changes to machine-based information resources are executed through the redeployment of version controlled resources rather than direct modification wherever reasonable.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: The effectiveness of documented change management procedures is persistently reviewed.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Persistent testing and validation of changes throughout deployment is automated.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: The functionality and privileges for infrastructure and services are strictly defined.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Automated services are used to persistently assess the security of all machine-based information resources and automatically enforce their intended operational state.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: The use and configuration of third-party machine-based information resources is persistently compared against the original provider's best practices and guidance.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Machine-based information resources are persistently reviewed to ensure they have a minimal attack surface and that lateral movement is minimized if compromised.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Machine-based information resources are persistently reviewed to ensure they are appropriately optimized for high availability and rapid recovery.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Machine-based information resources are persistently reviewed to ensure they are appropriately configured to limit inbound and outbound network traffic.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: The effectiveness of protection against denial of service attacks and other unwanted activity for machine-based information resources is persistently reviewed.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Logical networking and related capabilities are used and persistently reviewed to enforce traffic flow controls.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: The lifecycle and privileges of all accounts, roles, and groups are securely managed using automation.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Secure passwordless methods are used for user authentication and authorization when feasible, otherwise strong passwords with phishing-resistant MFA is used.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Identity and access management measures are used and persistently reviewed to ensure each user or device can only access the resources they need.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: A least-privileged, role and attribute-based, and just-in-time security authorization model is used and persistently reviewed for all user and non-user accounts and services.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Appropriately secure authentication methods are used and persistently reviewed for non-user accounts and services.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Accounts with privileged access are disabled or otherwise secured in response to suspicious activity.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Incident after action reports are generated and lessons learned are persistently incorporated.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: The effectiveness of documented incident response procedures is persistently reviewed.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Past incidents are persistently reviewed for patterns or vulnerabilities that were not previously apparent or identified.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: A least-privileged, role and attribute-based, and just-in-time access authorization model is used and persistently reviewed for access to log data based on organizationally defined data sensitivity.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: The configuration of machine-based information resources, especially infrastructure as code, is persistently evaluated and tested.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: A list of information resources and event types that will be logged, monitored, and audited is maintained and persistently reviewed to ensure these activities occur.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: A Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) or similar system(s) is used and persistently reviewed for centralized, tamper-resistant logging of events, activities, and changes.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Logs are persistently reviewed and audited.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Authoritative sources are used to automatically generate real-time inventories of all information resources when needed.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Executive support for achieving the provider's security goals is persistently reviewed and demonstrated.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: The effectiveness of the provider's investments in achieving security goals is persistently reviewed.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: The effectiveness of building security and privacy considerations into the Software Development Lifecycle and aligning with CISA Secure By Design principles is persistently reviewed.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: The effectiveness of the provider's vulnerability disclosure program is persistently reviewed.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: The alignment of machine-based information resource backups with defined recovery objectives is persistently reviewed.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: The alignment of recovery plans with defined recovery objectives is persistently reviewed.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: The desired Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) are defined and persistently reviewed for alignment with the provider's business needs and capabilities.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: The capability to recover from incidents and contingencies aligned with defined recovery objectives is persistently tested.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Persistently identify, review, and mitigate potential supply chain risks.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Third party software information resources are automatically monitored for upstream vulnerabilities using mechanisms that may include contractual notification requirements or active monitoring services.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: The configuration of machine-based information resources is managed using automation and persistently reviewed for drift.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Management, protection, and regular rotation of digital keys, certificates, and other secrets is automated and persistently reviewed.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Information resources are persistently evaluated for opportunities to improve security and those improvements are persistently made.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Plans, procedures, and the state of information resources are persistently reviewed after making changes to limit and remove unwanted residual elements that would likely negatively affect the confidentiality, integrity, or availability of federal customer data.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Unwanted federal customer data is removed promptly when requested by an agency in alignment with customer agreements, including from backups if appropriate; this typically applies when a customer spills information or when a customer seeks to remove information from a service due to a change in usage.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Information is encrypted or otherwise secured from unwanted access or modification.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: The authenticity and integrity of communications between machine-based information resources is persistently validated using automation.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Use cryptographic methods to validate the integrity of machine-based information resources.
